item.title: OpenAI Chat Completions and Spring AI
item.description:
The OpenAI Chat Completions API is a widely implemented JSON-over-HTTP interface for conversational language models. A client sends an ordered list of messages and generation options; the server returns one or more assistant messages with metadata and token usage.

Its basic shape is:

text 
HTTP client
 -> POST /v1/chat/completions
 -> request JSON containing messages and options
 -> model inference
 <- response JSON containing choices and usage

Many gateways and model servers implement an OpenAI-compatible endpoint even when the underlying model is not hosted by OpenAI. This makes the format a useful de facto interoperability API, but it is not an independent formal standard like HTTP, JSON-RPC, or MCP. Compatible providers may support different fields, models, limits, error formats, or extensions.

item.title: JSON Canonicalization
item.description:
JSON canonicalization turns semantically equivalent JSON data into one deterministic byte sequence. It is useful before hashing, signing, comparing, or using JSON as an identity key. Ordinary JSON serialization is not enough: object-member order, whitespace, escaping, and number formatting can differ without changing the data model.

JSON Canonicalization Scheme #

RFC 8785 defines the JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS). It uses the ECMAScript JSON serialization rules, serializes object properties in lexicographic order of UTF-16 code units, emits no insignificant whitespace, and requires valid I-JSON input.
